title: Landlord's Super
summary: First-person construction and life simulation set in fictional 1980s Britain, with hands-on property renovation, jobs, weather, time management and local characters. Reviews praise the unusual manual building loop and progression, while some report punitive setbacks and rough edges.

observations.statement: Hands-on construction tasks such as ordering supplies, mixing cement and building walls are repeatedly described as the game's distinctive simulation appeal.
Accessible reviews praise the grind-and-improve progression of restoring property and expanding what the player can do.
Some reviews report harsh setbacks or rough systems that can erase useful equipment or slow progress unexpectedly.

steam_reviews.query: Steam Community review pages; Russian and non-Russian lanes attempted; accessible index sampled without archiving raw review text
